jlink_mcp.title: J-Link MCP V1
jlink_mcp.description: Windows x64 local stdio MCP for one SEGGER J-Link target.
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; try { $root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\jlink-mcp'; $pointer = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'current.json') -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($pointer.schema_version -ne 1 -or $pointer.deployment -notmatch '^deployments/\d+\.\d+\.\d+-[a-f0-9]{16}(-[a-f0-9]{8})?$') { throw 'Invalid deployment pointer' }; & (Join-Path (Join-Path $root $pointer.deployment) 'scripts\launch-jlink-mcp.ps1'); exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('J-Link MCP is unavailable. Install the complete precompiled package with scripts/install-codex-plugin.ps1. ' + $_.Exception.Message); exit 127 }
